# Australian Public AI Register

> Open, provenance-gated dataset of Australian public-sector AI and migration.
> Every row carries its source URL and retrieval timestamp. CC BY 4.0.

Compiled and published by mindiam (https://mindiam.com). Data is sourced from
the Australian Bureau of Statistics, the Department of Home Affairs, AusTender
and Hansard. Each row records which of those it came from.

## What is here

- /data/nom-by-visa.csv: Net overseas migration by visa group, arrivals,
  departures and net, by state and territory, financial years from 2015.
  Source: ABS dataflow ABS_NOM_VISA_FY. 2,754 rows.

## How to use it

Every row has three provenance columns:
- source_url: the exact URL the row came from. For API-derived rows this is the
  precise query, so it can be re-run to reproduce the figure.
- source_retrieved_at: ISO 8601 retrieval timestamp.
- source_tier: "primary" for a public record, "claim" for a company
  announcement that is public but promotional.

## Citing

Cite the DOI of the release used. Attribution is the only licence condition.

## What this measures, and what it does not

Net overseas migration uses the ABS 12-in-16-month residency rule. It is NOT
the same measure as visa grants published by the Department of Home Affairs,
and the two legitimately differ. Do not treat them as interchangeable.

"Temporary visa - Total" includes visitors, who are not a migration programme
intake in the sense most policy discussion means. Use component rows, not the
total, for questions about programme settings.

Visa group is not occupation. This dataset supports statements about the
composition of the intake by visa class, not about which occupations migrants
enter.

## Disclosure

mindiam also publishes an opinion section, AI Policy Watch, which argues a
position on Australian AI and migration policy. That section is clearly
labelled as opinion and is editorially separate from this dataset. The data
here is not selected, filtered or framed to support it; the methodology is
published in full and the git history is a permanent audit trail.
